sentences.text: This Pacific bluefin tuna was tracked for {days_tracked}, from {first_date} to {last_date}.
Pacific bluefin tuna spawn in the western Pacific, and some young fish cross the ocean to feed off North America before returning west.
Its very last position was its farthest, {max_displacement_km} from where the track began.
Where it went after that, the record can't say.
